limitations.summary: We identify two sources of accuracy degradation: (i) nonuniform floatingpoint grids, which can limit weight reconstruction when rounding is restricted to adjacent levels; and (ii) nonnegative activations produced by nonlinearities, which leave negative quantization codes unused.
items: We identify two sources of accuracy degradation: (i) nonuniform floatingpoint grids, which can limit weight reconstruction when rounding is restricted to adjacent levels; and (ii) nonnegative activations produced by nonlinearities, which leave negative quantization codes unused.

We address these limitations by introducing a new quantization method, VisionMX, that extends adaptive rounding to nonuniform floating-point grids through rangerounding, allowing weight assignments to be optimized over a bounded range of quantization levels.
